Okay, here we go, I present you all a story that I enjoyed doing a lot, so much so that the story ended up having 988 pictures! And it also took me 3 weeks to finish making. It's been quite a long, long time since any story took me this long to do. Now again, this means that this story is a high quality one! A lot of effort, passion and time was poured on this one.

Here's a little synopsis for everyone to know what this story is about:
In a world where videogame mechanics and such are common knowledge and just how life is around here, a Demon God called Deimos started terrorizing humanity and waged war against them for centuries. Now, the present, Deimos was defeated and annihilated by a group of heroes, all that remains are the monsters that Deimos created which respawn every week thanks to the curse he placed on the world before he died. This story is about Reark, a warrior, and Amila, a cleric, whose ambition to become known thorough the whole world might not end up being what they expect!

If you want the story, you can support me in Fanbox and you will get a download link for you to keep! (Includes all my previous work and stories!)
